tvdb.title: Sasanishiki Is Going Home a Hero
tvdb.synopsis: Sasanishiki continues to refuse the invitations to join Love Rice. Then, for some reason, there's suddenly a train track running through the school yard, and a dog is trapped on the track as a train rushes toward it. Love Rice is frozen in place, but Sasanishiki rushes forward. Sasanishiki's skill and drive when it comes to Harvest Shows was once said to rival Koshihikari himself, but the story Morinokuma begins to tell about his past is one nobody expected...

tvdb.title: Say Mine! Koshihikari Shines
tvdb.synopsis: After feeling stimulated by Blast Resistance's concert, the members of Love Rice try to work on some new moves, but they can't seem to master the perfect technique. As they're left confused and frustrated, Koshihikari, the leader of Five Grain Rice and an alumnus of Inaho Academy, appears before them. Hinohikari, a HarveStar otaku, is enthralled to see his idol standing in front of him, but for the sake of Love Rice, he gets serious about undergoing Koshihikari's rigorous training...

tvdb.synopsis: Hinohikari and Nikomaru sneak into St. Pan High School to scope it out. They end up being caught by Yeast King's homeroom teacher, Crois, but Yeast King puts on their Harvest Show anyway, as if inviting the two of them to check out the competition. After witnessing the overwhelming difference in skill between their two groups, Hinohikari and Nikomaru can't help but respect their rivals. Then Crois comes up with a plan...

tvdb.title: Romantic Flight Toward Season 2
tvdb.synopsis: Love Rice managed to overcome their crisis thanks to Chinkobozu's Harvest Show. Rain suddenly started to fall as Love Rice made their return to the Harvest Festival venue. Will the wishes of Hinohikari, Sasanishiki, Hitomebore, Akitakomachi, and Nikomaru to restore the popularity of rice and keep the school open be granted? Can rice defeat bread? This emotional Love Kome-dy is about to reach its conclusion! Love Rice is forced to begin their Harvest Show without Hitomebore, but Yeast King sees that they're not performing at their full potential and stops them. The members of Yeast King feel ashamed of everything they've done to stand in Love Rice's way, and even more so when they find out who was behind Hitomebore's dilemma, so they offer to help. The desire to present their Harvest Shows fair and square leads to the sprouting of friendship between the two rival grains.
